scripts.build: npm run build -w libs/engine/core && npm run build -w libs/engine/angular && npm run build -w libs/engine/react && npm run build -w libs/engine/vue && npm run build -w libs/editor/core && npm run build -w libs/editor/angular && npm run build -w libs/editor/react && npm run build -w libs/editor/vue
scripts.dev:editor: npm run build:editor-dev -w libs/engine/core && npm run dev -w libs/editor/core
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:core && npm run e2e:demos
scripts.e2e:angular: npx playwright test --config=apps/core/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=core-angular && npx playwright test --config=apps/demos/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=demos-angular
scripts.e2e:react: npx playwright test --config=apps/core/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=core-react && npx playwright test --config=apps/demos/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=demos-react
scripts.e2e:vue: npx playwright test --config=apps/core/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=core-vue && npx playwright test --config=apps/demos/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=demos-vue
scripts.e2e:update-screenshots: npx playwright test --config=apps/core/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots=all && npx playwright test --config=apps/demos/_e2e/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots=all
